name: hardwareLifecycle
description: Hardware models in use, with their end-of-life and end-of-support dates and how many devices use each

getArgs.value: {{ (() => { const ids = (sel) => [].concat(sel || []).map((o) => Number([].concat(o.rawId)[0])).filter((n) => Number.isInteger(n)); const where = []; const b = ids(typeof building === 'undefined' ? [] : building); if (b.length) where.push('d.calculated_building_fk in (' + b.join(',') + ')'); const c = ids(typeof customer === 'undefined' ? [] : customer); if (c.length) where.push('d.customer_fk in (' + c.join(',') + ')'); const r = ids(typeof rack === 'undefined' ? [] : rack); if (r.length) where.push('d.calculated_rack_fk in (' + r.join(',') + ')'); const t = [].concat(typeof deviceType === 'undefined' ? [] : deviceType).map((x) => (x && x.value) || x)[0] || ''; if (['physical', 'virtual', 'cluster', 'blade', 'other', 'unknown'].includes(t)) where.push("d.type = '" + t + "'"); return 'select h.hardware_pk as hardware_id, h.name as hardware_model, v.name as manufacturer,' + ' h.end_of_life_date, h.end_of_support_date, count(d.device_pk) as devices' + ' from view_device_v2 d left join view_hardware_v2 h on h.hardware_pk = d.hardware_fk left join view_vendor_v1 v on v.vendor_pk = h.vendor_fk left join view_customer_v1 c on c.customer_pk = d.customer_fk left join view_building_v1 b on b.building_pk = d.calculated_building_fk left join view_room_v1 r on r.room_pk = d.calculated_room_fk left join view_rack_v1 k on k.rack_pk = d.calculated_rack_fk where d.hardware_fk is not null' + (where.length ? ' and ' + where.join(' and ') : '') + ' group by 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 order by 6 desc'; })() }}

metadata.name: lifecycle
metadata.valueExpression: {{ (() => { const now = Date.now(); const eol = $['end_of_life_date'] ? Date.parse($['end_of_life_date']) : NaN; const eos = $['end_of_support_date'] ? Date.parse($['end_of_support_date']) : NaN; if (eos <= now) return 'Out of support'; if (eol <= now) return 'End of life'; if (eos - now < 180 * 86400000) return 'Support ending soon'; if (Number.isFinite(eol) || Number.isFinite(eos)) return 'Supported'; return 'No dates recorded'; })() }}

metadata.name: lifecycleState
metadata.valueExpression: {{ ({ 'Out of support': 'error', 'End of life': 'warning', 'Support ending soon': 'warning', 'Supported': 'success' })[$['lifecycle']] || 'unknown' }}
